title.vi: Khiếu nại đến nơi đến chốn

goal.vi: Kể lại sự việc rõ ràng, giữ bình tĩnh khi bị từ chối, đặt hạn chót và gặp đúng người có thể giải quyết.
goal.en: Explain the history clearly, stay calm when they say no, say when it must be done and reach the right person.

dialogue.aRole: a customer service agent at an internet company
lines: Thanks for calling. How can I help?
I've contacted you twice, and my internet still hasn't been fixed.
I'm sorry. The earliest visit is next month.
I'm afraid that doesn't work for me. I work from home. What can you do to fix this sooner?
I can't change the schedule myself.
I understand. Could I speak to someone who can make a decision on this?
Let me ask my manager. We can come on Thursday.
Thank you. I'd like this fixed by Thursday, then. Could I get a reference number for this call?

phrases.say: I've contacted you twice, and it still hasn't been fixed.
phrases.not: I already contacted two times and still not fix.

mean.vi: Nêu rõ bạn đã báo nhiều lần mà chưa được giải quyết
mean.en: Say you asked before and it is still not fixed

why.vi: Kể lại sự việc rõ ràng, bình tĩnh, có số lần cụ thể.
why.en: Give the history clearly and calmly, with real numbers.

phrases.say: I'm afraid that doesn't work for me.

mean.vi: Từ chối một đề nghị một cách lịch sự
mean.en: Say no to an offer politely

why.vi: "I'm afraid…" làm lời từ chối dứt khoát nghe mềm hơn.
why.en: "I'm afraid…" makes a firm "no" sound softer.

phrases.say: What can you do to fix this sooner?

mean.vi: Hỏi họ có thể giúp gì
mean.en: Ask what they can do for you

why.vi: Câu hỏi mở mời họ tự đưa ra giải pháp.
why.en: An open question invites them to offer a solution.

phrases.say: Could I speak to someone who can make a decision on this?

mean.vi: Xin gặp người có quyền quyết định
mean.en: Ask for a person who can decide

why.vi: Xin gặp đúng người mà không tấn công người đang nghe máy.
why.en: Ask for the right person without attacking this one.

phrases.say: I'd like this fixed by Friday.

mean.en: Say when it must be done

why.vi: Dùng "by" cho hạn chót; "until" là suốt thời gian đến lúc đó.
why.en: Use "by" for the last day; "until" means all the time before.

phrases.say: Could I get a reference number for this call?
phrases.not: Give me the number of this talking.

mean.vi: Xin mã số cuộc gọi để theo dõi
mean.en: Ask for a number to follow the case

why.vi: Mã số giúp bạn khi phải gọi lại lần nữa.
why.en: A reference number helps if you need to call again.

phrases.say: If it's not fixed by then, I'll have to take this further.
phrases.not: If not, I will make a big problem.

mean.vi: Cảnh báo bình tĩnh rằng bạn sẽ khiếu nại lên cao hơn
mean.en: Calmly say you will complain to someone higher

why.vi: Lời cảnh báo bình tĩnh mạnh hơn lời nói giận dữ.
why.en: A calm warning is stronger than an angry one.

ai.name: Chris
ai.role: a customer service agent at an internet company
ai.persona: polite but follows the rules closely
ai.goal: keep the learner calm and follow company rules

roleplay.you: Your Wi-Fi at home has not worked for a week and you called twice. Explain this, say no to a late visit, ask for someone who can decide and get a reference number.

turns.a: Thanks for calling. How can I help?
turns.h: I've contacted you twice, and my internet still hasn't been fixed.

turns.a: The earliest visit is in three weeks.
turns.h: I'm afraid that doesn't work for me. What can you do to fix this sooner?
br: I can't change the schedule myself.

turns.a: Those are the rules, I'm sorry.
turns.h: I understand. Could I speak to someone who can make a decision on this?
br: One moment… Okay, we can come on Thursday.

turns.h: Yes, thank you. Could I get a reference number for this call?

roleplay.end: Your visit is booked for Thursday morning. Thanks for your patience.
